chienUnburiable.excuse: The Excuse cannot be buried in the chien.
chienUnburiable.bout: Bouts (Petit = trump 1, and the 21) cannot be buried in the chien.

tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick. You must follow the led suit; if you cannot, you must play a trump; failing that, any card. The highest trump wins the trick.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click a legal card to select it. French Tarot is a 4-player trick-taker on the 78-card tarot deck (four 14-card suits, 21 trumps, and the Excuse).
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. In the auction you pass or declare Petite / Garde / Garde Sans / Garde Contre. In the chien phase you bury 6 cards.
tutorial.info: French Tarot is a 4-player trick-taker on the 78-card deck. The highest bidder in the auction becomes the declarer versus three CPU defenders. On Petite/Garde the 6-card chien is revealed and merged into the hand, then 6 cards are buried. The declarer wins the deal by reaching a card-point target that depends on the number of bouts (trumps 1, 21, and the Excuse). Multipliers: Petite ×1, Garde ×2, Garde Sans ×4, Garde Contre ×6. The player with the highest cumulative score after the set number of deals wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
